cohort: 32 pregnancies in 28 kidney/ kidney-pancreas transplant recipients with live-born children
finding: Despite a high rate of preterm birth and low birth weight, children born to kidney/kidney-pancreas transplant recipients demonstrated age-appropriate development up to two years of age.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in the majority (75%) of the pregnancies.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 2.030 g, with almost 70% having low birth weights (< 2.500 g)
